Added `resolver.ClientConn.ReportError(error)`. Reported errors wake pending picks, and failfast RPCs return the error (or an `Unavailable` status containing it). A resolver state update clears the reported error, and reporting one counts as the first resolution event so RPCs can reach the picker.

I did not run tests.
